description: Radial layout with multiple concentric layers: outer segmented annuli, a ring of nodes (circles) on the perimeter, numerous internal connecting lines, and dense short radial lines near the center plus a small central circle.

components.description: Outermost thick annulus around the full circle, visually split into several colored arc segments.
Second annulus inside the outer ring, composed of shorter arc segments concentrated in a few sectors.
Perimeter ring of many evenly spaced small circles just inside the annuli.
Dense network of thin, mostly translucent straight connections spanning the interior, linking perimeter circles to other circles and toward the center.
Compact cluster of many short radial line marks near the center, forming a star-like pattern with alternating colors.
Small central circular node at the very center.

primary.explanation: The outer annulus is divided into several arc segments arranged around the circle; each item spans an angular range.
Short arc segments distributed around selected angular sectors of the inner annulus; approximately ten segments are visible.
Many evenly spaced small circles placed around the full circle at a fixed radius.
Each data item represents one edge in the network; edges are positioned by source/target nodes arranged around the circle.
Many short radial strokes arranged around the center across many evenly spaced angles.

secondary.explanation: Multiple short strokes per angle at increasing radii near the center.

primary.explanation: Single central circle at the origin; position controlled by radius only (angle is irrelevant at r=0).
